context.title: SMFC Education Foundation: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Mateo-Foster City School District — Measure W (Bond Measure)

positions.statement: Christina Ogburn-Chow (President, SMFC Education Foundation) signed the argument in favor of San Mateo-Foster City School District Measure W and the rebuttal to the argument against San Mateo-Foster City School District Measure W in the San Mateo County measure documents (resolutions, impartial analyses, arguments as filed), November 3, 2026 General Election voter guide.
